items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: I was with Faith Marvel's band.

ctx.x: And then... You went on a tour with him?

Yeah. Oh, yes. We... We made a tour of about 30... We... About 30 days. We played, uh... Cincinnati, Cleveland, Lamba, Ohio, uh... Columbus, and out in West Virginia, out in Springfield... Not Springfield, uh... Charleston, West Virginia, Wheeling, and, uh... Sandusky, and, and, uh... Oh, uh... Several other towns in, uh... And out in Ohio... And out in Ohio, in Indiana. Terry Houghton, and Indianapolis. We were out... We were out there about a whole month. A tour. And with... With Faith... I was with Faith…
Hmm. Yes. And, uh... You... You made... The records you made were... They were Jelly's name?
